correctness.rationale: All four distinct nonzero row-pattern cases are necessary and sufficient; inclusion-exclusion covers all sizes and the independent multinomial formula agrees. Generic two-factor encodings are exactly 2 per matrix; a union bound makes defective encodings exponentially rare. A degenerate two-sample expansion yields the exact factor mean, variance and square-order CLT. The standard-library checker agrees with exhaustive direct unions for all 25 rectangles of sizes 1..5 and with exact latent moments for N=1..4. All-size proof is structural, not extrapolated.

value.rationale: The exact cardinality polynomial is a natural size-refined model-count of a fixed split-independence formula, distinguishes sizes that preexisting Boolean rank totals collapse, and is computable by an explicit intersection-count sum rather than 2^(mn) brute force. The sharp 7/16 density and Gaussian 19/128 variance concern uniformly distinct models, requiring nontrivial representation-multiplicity control; they are not a trivial repeat of counts for random latent decompositions.
